provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

replica_nodes.description: Total number of replica nodes in the Data Centre.

replication_factor.description: The number of replica nodes that should be assigned for each master node.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

custom_virtual_network_id.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

block.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

advertised_hostname.description: The hostname to be used to connect to the PrivateLink cluster.

end_point_service_id.description: The Instaclustr ID of the AWS endpoint service

end_point_service_name.description: Name of the created endpoint service

block.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.
List of data centre settings.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

initial_permissions.description: Permissions initially granted to Redis user upon creation.

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

password_and_user_auth.description: Enables Password Authentication and User Authorization.

pci_compliance_mode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

valkey_version.description: Version of Valkey to run on the cluster. Available versions:

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

master_nodes.description: Total number of master nodes in the Data Centre. In order to maintain quorum on the cluster, you must specify an odd number of master nodes.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

replica_nodes.description: Total number of replica nodes in the Data Centre.

replication_factor.description: The number of replica nodes that should be assigned for each master node.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

custom_virtual_network_id.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

block.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

advertised_hostname.description: The hostname to be used to connect to the PrivateLink cluster.

end_point_service_id.description: The Instaclustr ID of the AWS endpoint service

end_point_service_name.description: Name of the created endpoint service

block.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.
List of data centre settings.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

initial_permissions.description: Permissions initially granted to Valkey user upon creation.

cloud_provider.description: The provider of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

name.description: The name of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

region.description: The region of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

status.description: The status of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

block.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which  allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

zookeeper_version.description: Version of Apache Zookeeper to run on the cluster. Available versions:

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

custom_subject_alternative_names.description: List of Subject Alternative Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter.

enforce_auth_schemes.description: A list of authentication schemes to enforce when enforce.auth.enabled=true.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of Zookeeper nodes in the Data Centre.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the Data Centre.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

continuous_backup.description: Enables commitlog backups and increases the frequency of the default snapshot backups.

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the Data Centre. Includes only Cassandra nodes, other node types in the cluster such as shotover nodes are excluded from this count. Must be a multiple of `replicationFactor`.

private_ip_broadcast_for_discovery.description: Enables broadcast of private IPs for auto-discovery.

private_link.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

private_service_connect_v2.description: Create a Private Service Connect enabled cluster.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

replication_factor.description: Number of racks to use when allocating nodes.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

domain.description: DNS zone domain name when provisioned (Route53 hosted zone).

hosted_zone_id.description: AWS Route 53 hosted zone ID for this zone (e.g. Z123...), when provisioned.

block.description: VPCs associated with this zone for private DNS resolution.
Cluster DNS hosted zones for this data centre: each entry is a DNS domain with the VPCs associated for private zone resolution.

cdc_id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

version.description:
The version of Shotover Proxy running on the Cluster.Available versions:
  • `0.7.3`

block.description: Details of the Shotover Proxy nodes provisioned for Private Link.

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.
List of data centre settings.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

version.description: Adds the specified version of Apache Spark to the Cassandra cluster. Available versions:

block.description: Adds the specified version of Apache Spark to the Cassandra cluster.

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

clickhouse_version.description:
Version of ClickHouse to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `25.8.24`
  • `26.3.10`

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

load_balancer_domain.description: Domain of the Network Load Balancer if enabled. Balances requests against nodes.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of Kafka brokers in the Data Centre. Must be a multiple of `defaultReplicationFactor`.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

id.description: ID of the PrivateLink listener. Only available after creation.

name.description: Name of the PrivateLink listener. Only available after creation.

port.description: Port of the PrivateLink listener. Only available after creation.

advertised_hostname.description: Name of the advertised host for this listener

end_point_service_id.description: The Instaclustr ID of the AWS endpoint service

end_point_service_name.description: Name of the created endpoint service

block.description: Details of PrivateLink related properties.
The additional listeners to create for a kafka cluster along with the default one.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

custom_virtual_network_id.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

block.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

advertised_hostname.description: The hostname to be used to connect to the PrivateLink cluster.

end_point_service_id.description: The Instaclustr ID of the AWS endpoint service

end_point_service_name.description: Name of the created endpoint service

block.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.
List of data centre settings.

controller_node_count.description: Number of dedicated KRaft Controller nodes. Must be 3 or 5.

controller_node_size.description: Size of the nodes provisioned as dedicated KRaftController nodes.

block.description: Provision additional dedicated nodes for KRaft Controllers. If this is not provided, some Kafka brokers will be required to act as KRaft controllers.

zookeeper_node_count.description: Number of dedicated Zookeeper node count, it must be 3 or 5.

zookeeper_node_size.description: Size of the nodes provisioned as dedicated Zookeeper nodes.

block.description: Provision additional dedicated nodes for Apache Zookeeper to run on. Zookeeper nodes will be co-located with Kafka if this is not provided

integrate_rest_proxy_with_schema_registr.description: Enables Integration of the Karapace REST proxy with the local Karapace Schema registry.

version.description:
Adds the specified version of Kafka REST Proxy to the Kafka cluster. Available versions:
  • `5.2.0`
  • `5.0.0`

block.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Karapace REST Proxy to this Kafka cluster.

version.description:
Adds the specified version of Kafka Schema Registry to the Kafka cluster. Available versions:
  • `5.0.0`
  • `5.2.0`

block.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Karapace Schema Registry to this Kafka cluster.

controller_node_count.description: Number of KRaft controller nodes (only 3 is currently supported).

block.description:
Create a collocated KRaft Cluster.

Note that this is the default behaviour for Kafka clusters provisioned using Kafka 3.6.1 and later.
Kafka clusters provisioned with earlier Kafka versions will use a collocated Zookeeper cluster instead.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

integrate_rest_proxy_with_schema_registr.description: Enables Integration of the REST proxy with a Schema registry.

schema_registry_password.description: Password to use when connecting to the Kafka schema registry. Requires 'integrateRestProxyWithSchemaRegistry' to be 'true' and useLocalSchemaRegistry to be 'false'.

schema_registry_server_url.description: URL of the Kafka schema registry to integrate with. Requires 'integrateRestProxyWithSchemaRegistry' to be 'true' and useLocalSchemaRegistry to be 'false'.

schema_registry_username.description: Username to use when connecting to the Kafka schema registry. Requires 'integrateRestProxyWithSchemaRegistry' to be 'true' and useLocalSchemaRegistry to be 'false'.

use_local_schema_registry.description: Integrates the REST proxy with the Schema registry attached to this cluster. Requires 'integrateRestProxyWithSchemaRegistry' to be 'true'.

version.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka REST Proxy to the Kafka cluster. Available versions:

block.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka REST Proxy to this Kafka cluster.

version.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Schema Registry to the Kafka cluster. Available versions:

block.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Schema Registry to this Kafka cluster.

gcs_bucket_name.description: GCS bucket name for Kafka remote storage

prefix.description: GCS prefix to store the remote data in the GCS bucket, by default the prefix format is `<cluster_id>-data/`

block.description: Defines the GCS bucket that will be used to store remote objects for GCP tiered storage.

prefix.description: S3 prefix to store the remote data in the S3 bucket, by default the prefix format is `<cluster_id>-data/`

s3_bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name for Kafka remote storage

block.description: Defines the information to access S3 bucket used for remote storage.   Access could be provided via Access and Secret key pair or IAM Role ARN. If neither is provided, access policy is defaulted to be provided later.
Enable Tiered Storage for Kafka

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

allow_delete_topics.description: Allows topics to be deleted via the kafka-topics tool

auto_create_topics.description: Allows topics to be auto created by brokers when messages are published to a non-existent topic

client_broker_auth_with_mtls.description: Enables Client ⇄ Broker Authentication with mTLS.

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

default_number_of_partitions.description: Default number of partitions to use when created new topics.

default_replication_factor.description: Default Replication factor to use for new topic. Also represents the number of racks to use when allocating nodes.

default_user_password.description: Password for the default Kafka user

kafka_version.description:
Version of Kafka to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `3.9.2`
  • `3.9.1`
  • `4.1.1`
  • `4.1.2`
  • `4.2.1`

pci_compliance_mode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

enabled.description: Toggle to enable or disable Client Telemetry for Kafka.

endpoint_url.description: URL to which the client telemetry will be sent.

block.description: Optional HTTP headers for the client telemetry endpoint (for example API key or custom authentication headers). When any entry is provided, each must include a non-empty key and value. Duplicate header names are not permitted.

password.description: Password for basic authentication when shipping client telemetry.

username.description: Username for basic authentication when shipping client telemetry.

block.description: Basic authentication settings for Client Telemetry endpoint.
Enable Client Telemetry for Kafka

Create a Collocated Zookeeper Cluster - use this to create
a collocated zookeeper based Kafka cluster for kafka versions >= 3.6.1.

Note that collocated KRaft mode is the default mode for Kafka clusters using versions older than 3.6.1.
Kafka 3.6.1 and later will use KRaft instead of Zookeeper unless this is specified.

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

cluster_dns.description: Enable cluster DNS for the data centre. When enabled, a DNS entry is created for this CDC pointing to cluster nodes, with additional addresses per node purpose. Incompatible with Private Link clusters.

custom_subject_alternative_names.description: List of Subject Alternate Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

node_size.description:
Size of the nodes provisioned in the Data Centre. Available node sizes:

use_private_ips.description: Whether or not to connect to source cluster's private IP addresses.

block.description: Details to connect to a Instaclustr managed cluster. Cannot be provided if targeting a non-Instaclustr managed cluster.
Details to connect to the source kafka cluster
List of all mirrors in the cluster.

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

kafka_connect_version.description:
Version of Kafka connect to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `3.9.2`
  • `3.9.1`
  • `4.1.1`
  • `4.2.1`
  • `4.1.2`

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

access_key.description: AWS Access Key id that can access your specified S3 bucket for Kafka Connect custom connector.

s3_bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name for Kafka Connect custom connector.

s3_role_arn.description: AWS Identity Access Management role that is used for accessing your specified S3 bucket for Kafka Connect custom connector

secret_key.description: AWS Secret Key associated with the Access Key id that can access your specified S3 bucket for Kafka Connect custom connector.

block.description: Defines the information to access custom connectors located in a S3 bucket. Cannot be provided if custom connectors are stored in GCP or AZURE. Access could be provided via Access and Secret key pair or IAM Role ARN. If neither is provided, access policy is defaulted to be provided later.

storage_account_key.description: Azure storage account key to access your Azure bucket for Kafka Connect custom connector.

storage_account_name.description: Azure storage account name to access your Azure bucket for Kafka Connect custom connector.

storage_container_name.description: Azure storage container name for Kafka Connect custom connector.

block.description: Defines the information to access custom connectors located in an azure storage container. Cannot be provided if custom connectors are stored in GCP or AWS.

client_email.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

client_id.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

private_key.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

private_key_id.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

project_id.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

storage_bucket_name.description: Access information for the GCP Storage bucket for kafka connect custom connectors.

block.description: Defines the information to access custom connectors located in a gcp storage container. Cannot be provided if custom connectors are stored in AWS or AZURE.
Defines the location for custom connector storage and access info.

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the Data Centre. Must be a multiple of `replicationFactor`.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

replication_factor.description: Number of racks to use when allocating nodes.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

node_size.description: Size of the nodes provisioned in the Data Centre. --AVAILABLE_NODE_SIZES_MARKER_V2_MONGODB--

number_of_nodes.description: Total number of MongoDB nodes in the Data Centre.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

notifications_plugin.description: Enables notifications plugin. For OpenSearch 2.x and later, if you want to enable this plugin you must also enable the Alerting plugin.

block.description: List of cluster managers node settings

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

number_of_racks.description: Number of racks to use when allocating data nodes.

private_link.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

private_link_endpoint_service_name.description: PrivateLink Endpoint Service name. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

private_link_rest_api_url.description: PrivateLink REST API URL. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

backup_bucket.description: Specify the S3 bucket to use for storing backup data for the cluster data centre. Only available for customers running in their own cloud provider accounts.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

backup_storage_account.description: Specify the Storage Account to use for storing backup data for the cluster data centre. Only available for customers running in their own cloud provider accounts.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

custom_virtual_network_id.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

disable_snapshot_auto_expiry.description: This field is accepted but ignored. All GCP OpenSearch clusters now use backup buckets with no expiry policy regardless of this setting. Previously controlled whether the GCS backup bucket should automatically expire data after 7 days.

block.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

private_endpoint.description: Private endpoint to connect a client to the node.

private_link_connection_url.description: PrivateLink URL to connect clients to the node if PrivateLink is enabled on the cluster.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

public_endpoint.description: Public endpoint to connect a client to the node. Not applicable to Private IP only clusters.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

dedicated_data_node.description: Indicates if the data nodes on the cluster is dedicated data node or not. All data nodes will be converted to dedicated data nodes if ingest nodes are added, and new data nodes will be added as dedicated data nodes if the cluster has ingest nodes.

block.description: List of openSearch dashboards settings

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

cluster_id.description: ID of the target cluster used for the restore operation.

index_names.description:
A comma separated list of index names which follows the format `index1,index2`

If provided, only data for the specified indices will be restored, for the point in time. If not provided, all indices will be restored for the point in time.

point_in_time.description:
Timestamp in milliseconds since epoch or ISO formatted date and time (example - 2023-11-05T13:15:30Z). All backed up data will be restored for this point in time.

Defaults to the current date and time.

restore_mode.description:
Determines the target VPC for restored cluster. Accepted values are:
  • NEW_VPC - restores the cluster to a new VPC.
  • SAME_VPC - restores the cluster to the same VPC as the original cluster, for customers running in their own account.
    • AWS - restore to a new Cidr within the CDC's network
    • GCP - For customer-managed network, if the source cluster specifies a host project, it will be restored to that project. If the source cluster specifies a custom subnet, it will be restored to that custom subnet. If nothing is specified, it will restore to a new Cidr within the CDC network.
    • Azure - currently not supported.
  • CUSTOM_VPC - restores the cluster to a custom VPC for customers running in their own account. Customers need to specify the customVpcSettings including network and vpcId.
    • AWS - restores the cluster to the network Cidr and vpc specified by the customer
    • GCP - For customer-managed network, if the vpcId field contains the projects/ pattern, it will be restored to that project. If the vpcId field contains the subnetworks/ pattern, it will be restored to that custom subnet. If nothing is specified, it will restore to a new Cidr within the CDC network.
    • Azure - restores the cluster to the network Cidr and VNet specified by the customer.
    CUSTOM_VPC and SAME_VPC options are available only for customers running in their own account.

block.description: Triggers a restore operation when provided during cluster creation. Contains the settings for the restore request.

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

name.description: Name of channel/desination assosciated with webhook

open_search_binding_id.description: OpenSearch ID for alerting/notifications channel/destination for webhook

source.description: Source OpenSearch plugin that manages the channel/destination

cluster_data_centre_id.description: ID of the AWS VPC cluster data centre the bucket permission is attached to

cluster_id.description: ID of the OpenSearch cluster to attach the bucket to

s3_bucket_name.description: Name of the external S3 bucket

s3_prefixes.description: S3 path prefixes to restrict read-only access to within the bucket

alerting_plugin.description: Enables alerting plugin. For OpenSearch 2.x and later, if you want to enable this plugin you must also enable the Notifications plugin.

anonymous_auth_enabled.description: Enable anonymous authentication. Allows unauthenticated requests with restricted  permissions. Requires Private Network Cluster. Not available when PCI compliance mode is enabled.

aws_instance_role_arn.description: ARN of the instance role for the nodes in the OpenSearch cluster. This ARN needs to be trusted by the role matching `awsSecretsManagerIamRoleArn` for OpenSearch to successfully boot up with Portal26.

aws_secrets_manager_byok_config_prefix.description: Prefix for the BYOK config's secret name on AWS Secrets Manager.

aws_secrets_manager_iam_role_arn.description: ARN of the IAM role that has read-only access to AWS Secrets Manager.

aws_secrets_manager_region.description: AWS region for AWS Secrets Manager that contains the Portal26 license and BYOK configuration.

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

default_user_password.description: Password of the default user created for the OpenSearch cluster.

default_username.description: Username of the default user created for the OpenSearch cluster.

gcp_instance_service_account.description: Service account of the instance for the nodes in the OpenSearch cluster. This service account principal needs to be provided access to the service account matching `gcpSecretsManagerServiceAccount` for OpenSearch to successfully boot up with Portal26.

gcp_secrets_manager_byok_config_prefix.description: Prefix for the BYOK config's secret name on GCP Secrets Manager.

gcp_secrets_manager_project_id.description: GCP Project ID which contains the secrets.

gcp_secrets_manager_region.description: GCP region for regional GCP Secrets Manager that contains the Portal26 license and BYOK configuration. Omit this setting if the secrets are stored globally.

gcp_secrets_manager_service_account.description: Service Account that has read-only access to GCP Secrets Manager.

ingest_nodes_load_balancer_connection_ur.description: URL of the Ingest Nodes specific Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster. Balances request loads against nodes with the ingest role. Recommended for clusters with dedicated ingest nodes.

leader_cluster_account.description: The leader cluster account ID for a Cross Cluster Replication enabled follower cluster. This requires crossClusterReplicationPlugin to be set to true.

leader_cluster_id.description: Specifies the leader cluster ID for a Cross Cluster Replication enabled follower cluster. This requires crossClusterReplicationPlugin to be set to true. Not defining this will make the cluster a leader cluster if crossClusterReplicationPlugin is set to true.

license_secret_name_prefix.description: Specifies the prefix path to the Portal26 license in Secrets Manager.  For example if you have specify `prefix1`, you must store the `titaniam.license` secret in AWS Secrets Manager with the secret key `prefix1titaniam.licence` in AWS, and `prefix1titaniam-license` on GCP.

load_balancer_connection_url.description: URL of the Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster. Balances request loads against all nodes in the cluster except for ingest nodes.

notifications_plugin.description: Enables notifications plugin. For OpenSearch 2.x and later, if you want to enable this plugin you must also enable the Alerting plugin.

opensearch_major_version.description: Major version of OpenSearch to run on the cluster. Must be provided if `opensearchVersion` is not provided.

opensearch_version.description:
Version of OpenSearch to run on the cluster. Must be provided if `opensearchMajorVersion` is not provided. Available versions:
  • `2.19.4`
  • `2.19.5`
  • `3.3.2`
  • `3.5.0`
  • `3.6.0`

pci_compliance_mode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

portal26_plugin.description: Whether or not the Portal26 plugin is enabled for this cluster.

private_endpoint.description: Private endpoint to connect clients to the cluster.

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

public_endpoint.description: Public endpoint to connect clients to the cluster. Not applicable to Private IP only clusters.

searchable_snapshots.description: Enable searchable snapshots. Available only for OpenSearch versions 2.7.0 or higher.

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

block.description: List of cluster managers node settings

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

number_of_racks.description: Number of racks to use when allocating data nodes.

private_link.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

private_link_endpoint_service_name.description: PrivateLink Endpoint Service name. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

private_link_rest_api_url.description: PrivateLink REST API URL. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

provider_account_name.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

tag_management_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

zero_inbound_access.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

backup_bucket.description: Specify the S3 bucket to use for storing backup data for the cluster data centre. Only available for customers running in their own cloud provider accounts.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

ebs_encryption_key.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

backup_storage_account.description: Specify the Storage Account to use for storing backup data for the cluster data centre. Only available for customers running in their own cloud provider accounts.

custom_virtual_network_id.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

resource_group.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

storage_network.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

block.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

custom_virtual_network_id.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

disable_snapshot_auto_expiry.description: This field is accepted but ignored. All GCP OpenSearch clusters now use backup buckets with no expiry policy regardless of this setting. Previously controlled whether the GCS backup bucket should automatically expire data after 7 days.

block.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

deletion_time.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

node_roles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

private_address.description: Private IP address of the node.

private_endpoint.description: Private endpoint to connect a client to the node.

private_link_connection_url.description: PrivateLink URL to connect clients to the node if PrivateLink is enabled on the cluster.

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node.

public_endpoint.description: Public endpoint to connect a client to the node. Not applicable to Private IP only clusters.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

start_time.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

block.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.
List of data centre settings.

dedicated_data_node.description: Indicates if the data nodes on the cluster is dedicated data node or not. All data nodes will be converted to dedicated data nodes if ingest nodes are added, and new data nodes will be added as dedicated data nodes if the cluster has ingest nodes.

private_link_url.description: PrivateLink URL to access OpenSearch Dashboards, if PrivateLink is enabled for the cluster.

version.description:
Version of dashboard to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `2.19.5`
  • `3.3.0`
  • `2.19.4`
  • `3.5.0`
  • `3.6.0`

block.description: List of openSearch dashboards settings

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

downsize_acknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

notify_support_contacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

block.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

cluster_id.description: ID of the target cluster used for the restore operation.

index_names.description:
A comma separated list of index names which follows the format `index1,index2`

If provided, only data for the specified indices will be restored, for the point in time. If not provided, all indices will be restored for the point in time.

point_in_time.description:
Timestamp in milliseconds since epoch or ISO formatted date and time (example - 2023-11-05T13:15:30Z). All backed up data will be restored for this point in time.

Defaults to the current date and time.

restore_mode.description:
Determines the target VPC for restored cluster. Accepted values are:
  • NEW_VPC - restores the cluster to a new VPC.
  • SAME_VPC - restores the cluster to the same VPC as the original cluster, for customers running in their own account.
    • AWS - restore to a new Cidr within the CDC's network
    • GCP - For customer-managed network, if the source cluster specifies a host project, it will be restored to that project. If the source cluster specifies a custom subnet, it will be restored to that custom subnet. If nothing is specified, it will restore to a new Cidr within the CDC network.
    • Azure - currently not supported.
  • CUSTOM_VPC - restores the cluster to a custom VPC for customers running in their own account. Customers need to specify the customVpcSettings including network and vpcId.
    • AWS - restores the cluster to the network Cidr and vpc specified by the customer
    • GCP - For customer-managed network, if the vpcId field contains the projects/ pattern, it will be restored to that project. If the vpcId field contains the subnetworks/ pattern, it will be restored to that custom subnet. If nothing is specified, it will restore to a new Cidr within the CDC network.
    • Azure - restores the cluster to the network Cidr and VNet specified by the customer.
    CUSTOM_VPC and SAME_VPC options are available only for customers running in their own account.

block.description: Triggers a restore operation when provided during cluster creation. Contains the settings for the restore request.

confirmation_email.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

confirmation_phone_number.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

id.description: Instaclustr identifier for the PostgreSQL configuration property. The value of this property has the form: [cluster-id]|[configuration_name]

block.description: List of configuration properties

current_cluster_operation_status.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

default_user_password.description: Password of the default user created for the PostgreSQL cluster.

pci_compliance_mode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

postgresql_version.description:
Version of Postgresql to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `18.4.0`
  • `17.10.0`

private_network_cluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

sla_tier.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

synchronous_mode_strict.description: Create the PostgreSQL cluster with the selected replication mode, see [PostgreSQL replication mode](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/postgresql/options/replication-mode/).

cloud_provider.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

custom_subject_alternative_names.description: List of Subject Alternative Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

load_balancer_endpoint.description: DNS name of the Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.
